name: Milwaukee-Eight
notes: Modern Harley big-twin family used across many Softail and Touring models. Confirm exact displacement and tune by year and VIN — do not assume one map fits all.

name: Twin Cam
notes: Previous-generation big twin found on many used Touring and Softail bikes. Service history and cam-related maintenance matter on higher-mile examples.

name: Evolution Sportster
era: Classic Sportster era through early 2020s air-cooled models
notes: Air-cooled Sportster motors on Iron 883, Forty-Eight, and related models. Simpler mechanical story than liquid-cooled platforms.

name: Revolution Max
notes: Liquid-cooled platform powering Sportster S, Nightster, and Pan America. Different service and feel than traditional air-cooled Harleys.
